about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Seth Magaziner

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BANNING STOCK TRADING BY ELECTED OFFICIALS
statements.title: BANNING STOCK TRADING BY ELECTED OFFICIALS
sentences: We have a mandate for change, and that starts with finally, at long last, banning Members of Congress and the President from trading stocks.
More than 100 candidates for Congress ran television ads calling for a congressional stock trading ban in the last election.

It must fully ban buying, owning, and selling individual stocks altogether, and it must include the President of the United States, whose net worth has grown by $3 billion in the last 2 years and who has traded more stocks than every Member of Congress combined.
Banning stock trading in Congress and the White House must be part of a larger effort to root out corruption here in Washington.
They want to heat their homes this winter and put food on their table free of the burden of the President's tariffs.
They want to keep our country out of unnecessary wars, like the war in Iran that is driving up gas prices.
Let's build a country that is not just a playground for billionaires, but a land of opportunity for everyone.
Under the leadership of Speaker Jeffries, we will be ready to move swiftly and deliver.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING EMOTIONAL ASSISTANCE WITH RELIEF AND LOVE ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING EMOTIONAL ASSISTANCE WITH RELIEF AND LOVE ACT
sentences: The men and women of the U.S. Customs and Border Protection face high levels of stress and exposure to trauma in their day-to-day operations.
It is good for law enforcement.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 9327, the Providing Emotional Assistance with Relief and Love Act, or the PEARL Act.
Mr. Speaker, once again, I urge my colleagues to support this legislation, the PEARL Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRANSPORTATION WORKER IDENTIFICATION CREDENTIAL EFFICIENCY ACT
statements.title: TRANSPORTATION WORKER IDENTIFICATION CREDENTIAL EFFICIENCY ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 5109, the TWICE Act, a sensible bill that will help make it easier for individuals who were formerly incarcerated and seeking to work at our Nation's seaports.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NORTHERN BORDER SECURITY ENHANCEMENT AND REVIEW ACT
statements.title: NORTHERN BORDER SECURITY ENHANCEMENT AND REVIEW ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 5517, the Northern Border Security Enhancement and Review Act.
This bill simply requires DHS to conduct a recurring northern border threat analysis and to update their northern border strategy accordingly.
It also requires CBP's Air and Marine Operations to create performance metrics to assess the effectiveness of securing the northern border.
Mr. Speaker, I once again urge my colleagues to support H.R. 5517, the Northern Border Security Enhancement and Review Act.

The Department of Homeland Security should be keeping a close eye on all threats to the American people, including any threats coming across the northern border, and it should be able to measure whether its actions are having an impact.
Mr. Speaker, I support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LINKING FAMILY MEMBERS THROUGHOUT THE NEXUS APPLICATION PROCESS
statements.title: LINKING FAMILY MEMBERS THROUGHOUT THE NEXUS APPLICATION PROCESS
sentences: I think it bears saying at this moment that we should also recognize that our neighbor to the north, Canada, is an ally and a friend, and that we should be encouraging free flow of people and goods across the border to the greatest extent possible while keeping America safe.
I also urge my colleagues to support H.R. 9382, the NEXUS for families act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CIVIL PREPAREDNESS FOR AGROTERRORISM EXERCISE ACT OF 2026
statements.title: CIVIL PREPAREDNESS FOR AGROTERRORISM EXERCISE ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I support this bill.
It is a good bill, a necessary bill, and I urge my colleagues to support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY INTELLIGENCE AND ANALYSIS TRAINING ACT
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY INTELLIGENCE AND ANALYSIS TRAINING ACT
sentences: Now, this office plays a critical role in protecting the American people from violence by collecting, analyzing, and disseminating intelligence to State, local, Tribal, territorial, and private-sector law enforcement.

Importantly, my bill ensures that the standardized training program include mandatory training on civil rights, civil liberties, privacy rights, regulations, and information practices for all hires on day one.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of my bill, H.R. 7436, the Department of Homeland Security Intelligence and Analysis Training Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: I&A MISSION REORIENTATION ACT OF 2026
statements.title: I&A MISSION REORIENTATION ACT OF 2026
sentences: One of the major contributing factors that allowed September 11 to occur was a lack of adequate information sharing between intelligence and law enforcement agencies.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote in support of this bill, and I thank my colleague from the committe, Mr. Pfluger, for his leadership on this issue.
I support this bipartisan piece of legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAIL BALLOT WHISTLEBLOWER
statements.title: MAIL BALLOT WHISTLEBLOWER
sentences: A whistleblower has revealed that the Trump administration has directed the United States Postal Service to secretly build an untested, illegal system to intercept mail ballots on their way to State election administrators.

The whistleblower reports that under this new system, the Trump administration is building their own list of who they think should be eligible to vote, and Postal Service workers will be required to scan bar codes on ballots to see if the voter appears on the Trump administration's list, a list that has not been made publicly available.
President Trump knows Republicans can't win the midterm elections on the merits--not with this economy, not with these tariffs, not with this war.
Vote by mail is how millions of Americans, especially seniors, exercise their right to vote.
There is no evidence of widespread voter fraud in American elections.
Iran War Mr. Speaker, the President's unnecessary war in Iran has now lasted 6 months with no end in sight.
We could have repaired 80,000 bridges, made insulin free for every American who needs it, and given a $1,000 tax cut to every middle-class family.
When Democrats take back the majority, we will end this nonsense.
We will fight for every Americans' right to vote and defend our democracy from those who seek to undermine it from within.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
statements.title: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, House Republicans are pushing a voter suppression bill that would severely restrict the mail ballots that seniors, rural Americans, and so many others rely on, and would throw our elections into chaos late in the cycle while people are already casting their ballots.

They are trying to trick us into supporting their voter suppression bill by calling it the Stop Insider Trading Act and including watered down language that would still allow Members of Congress to own stocks and to trade stocks with only some new restrictions.
The Republican leadership is trying to trick us into supporting it by calling it a congressional stock trading ban, even though it doesn't actually fully ban congressional stock trading.

This bill also does nothing to stop the biggest stock trader in Washington, President Trump, who has made millions of dollars trading stocks for the companies that he regulates--tech companies, healthcare companies, defense companies, and more.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO MORE ENDLESS WARS
statements.title: NO MORE ENDLESS WARS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, in recent days, three more American servicemembers have been killed in the Iran war, while another is missing, and 1,600 civilians have been killed--not combatants--with our tax dollars.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ICE SHOOTINGS
statements.title: ICE SHOOTINGS
sentences: In both of these shootings in Texas and in Maine, none of the agents were wearing their body cameras.
Congress gave them tens of millions of dollars for body cameras, and none of them were wearing them.
Do you want to know why I won't vote to give funding to this lawless, reckless, dangerous agency?
We are not going to be silent about what is happening.
We are not going to forget until there is justice. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 8800, NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 8595, NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPA
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 8800, NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 8595, NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED...
sentences: It is because our Republican colleagues passed the big, ugly bill last year that cut funding from healthcare in order to fund tax cuts for billionaires and big corporations.
They said that maybe if they change the name, then people will like the fact that they can't afford to go to the doctor anymore because of our tax cuts for the rich.

Why aren't the American people grateful for the fact that whatever small tax relief was included for the middle class is outweighed dramatically by the increased costs from the tariffs, the war, and health insurance premiums skyrocketing?
How about we fund education instead of yet more tax cuts for Elon Musk and the billionaires partying at Mar-a-Lago while working people suffer?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNNECESSARY WARS IN MIDDLE EAST
statements.title: UNNECESSARY WARS IN MIDDLE EAST
sentences: In the 6 months since the unnecessary war in Iran began, over a dozen U.S. servicemembers have lost their lives.
Iran still controls the strait.
There are no guarantees for inspections of nuclear sites, and there are no guarantees that Iran will stop funding terror.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WAGE INCREASES AND CORPORATE PROFITS
statements.title: WAGE INCREASES AND CORPORATE PROFITS
sentences: You are doing great if you are a billionaire partying at Mar- a-Lago or a hedge fund manager.
We passed a $4 trillion tax cut for the rich and big corporations.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STATE OF CIVIL RIGHTS IN AMERICA TODAY
statements.title: STATE OF CIVIL RIGHTS IN AMERICA TODAY
sentences: However, in the last few weeks, at the urging of the President, the Supreme Court effectively overturned section 2 of the Voting Rights Act, which had been the law of the land for decades.
Since then, Republican Governors and State legislators across the South have been racing to break up majority Black and Hispanic congressional districts.

What a shameful way for Republicans to try to win elections, by breaking up majority-Black and Hispanic districts, to try to rob those voters from being able to elect their chosen Representatives in Congress.
Seventy percent of the House Democratic Caucus are women, people of color, or LGBTQ.

I want to be on the side that honors the legacy of King, Parks, Lewis, and other civil rights heroes, not the side moving at breakneck speed to try to break up majority-minority districts and rob people of color in our country from their chosen representation.
As long as we are willing to do the work, we will move past this troubling chapter in our Nation's history, and our country's better angels will prevail. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION VANITY PROJECTS
statements.title: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION VANITY PROJECTS
sentences: He wants to spend millions more to build an arch as a monument to himself, while parents can't afford childcare for their children.
He is spending millions on a no-bid contract to repaint the reflecting pool, while small businesses are closing down because of the high costs of energy caused by his unnecessary Iran war.

This is all taxpayer money we are talking about, by the way, and the Rhode Islanders whom I speak to don't understand why our colleagues in Congress are putting more energy into trying to use their taxpayer money to lavish the President with gifts and monuments instead of making healthcare more affordable for the American people, along with housing, food, and childcare.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: POWERFUL CORPORATIONS MUST PAY THEIR FAIR SHARE OF TAXES
statements.title: POWERFUL CORPORATIONS MUST PAY THEIR FAIR SHARE OF TAXES
sentences: This is why we need to get dark money out of elections.
This is why we need to end congressional stock trading.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FUNDING FOR RESEARCH UNDER THREAT
statements.title: FUNDING FOR RESEARCH UNDER THREAT
sentences: The war in Iran is costing us more than a billion dollars a day.
We will spend more on the war in Iran in 1 week than we spend on cancer research in an entire year.
Stock-Trading Ban Mr. Speaker, it has been exactly 1 year since Speaker Johnson said that he supports a stock-trading ban for Members of Congress.

We need to pass a congressional stock-trading ban because it is not fair that Members of Congress have access to inside information that influences major industries--the pharmaceutical industry, the tech industry, and others--and can trade off of that information that average Americans don't have.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
sentences: The administration has not given us any evidence--and I have gone to every briefing, classified briefings and otherwise--any evidence that Iran was plotting an imminent threat against the United States, an imminent attack, any evidence that they were close to getting a nuclear weapon--none.
We have an opportunity to end it today, and I urge my colleagues to do that.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WASHINGTON IS BROKEN
statements.title: WASHINGTON IS BROKEN
sentences: Instead of voting to end the war, end the tariffs, and lower healthcare costs, what are we doing?
The oil companies are making money off the Iran war.

We need to pass a congressional stock trading ban, get dark money out of elections, and make this city work for the people again so that working Americans can afford to pay their bills. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WASHINGTON, D.C. CORRUPTION IS OUT OF CONTROL
statements.title: WASHINGTON, D.C. CORRUPTION IS OUT OF CONTROL
sentences: The President himself has made billions selling cryptocurrencies since he took office.
Meanwhile, Members of Congress can trade stocks of companies that we vote to regulate and can go to online prediction markets to bet on whether bills that we wrote are going to pass or not.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IT IS TIME FOR CHANGE
statements.title: IT IS TIME FOR CHANGE
sentences: Until we get dark money out of elections, until we pass my bill to ban stock trading in Congress, until we take anticorruption seriously, then too many politicians will continue to work for the big, powerful corporations instead of for the American people who sent us here.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ESTABLISHING A SELECT COMMITTEE ON AGING
statements.title: ESTABLISHING A SELECT COMMITTEE ON AGING
sentences: I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to support it for today's seniors and for future generations.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PERMISSION FOR MEMBER TO BE CONSIDERED AS FIRST SPONSOR OF H.R. 537
statements.title: PERMISSION FOR MEMBER TO BE CONSIDERED AS FIRST SPONSOR OF H.R. 537
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent that I may hereafter be considered to be the first sponsor of H.R. 537, INCREASE Housing Affordability Act, a bill originally introduced by Representative Sherrill of New Jersey, for the purpose of adding cosponsors and requesting reprintings pursuant to clause 7 of rule XII.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RELATING TO A NATIONAL EMERGENCY BY THE PRESIDENT ON FEBRUARY 1, 2025
statements.title: RELATING TO A NATIONAL EMERGENCY BY THE PRESIDENT ON FEBRUARY 1, 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, President Trump's tariffs are raising costs on working people.
Just like everything else that Donald Trump does, his tariffs are all about helping himself and his rich friends at the expense of everyday people.
Wouldn't you know it, Mr. Speaker, he exempted them from the tariffs.
In Donald Trump's America, the rich and connected are always taken care of, and everyone else struggles.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REWRITING HISTORY
statements.title: REWRITING HISTORY
sentences: They do not want people to know about the struggle that went into building this more perfect Union.
A 25-year-old DOGE employee wrote: ``You could not pay me to marry outside my ethnicity,'' and, ``Normalize Indian hate.'' This came to light a year ago.
We cannot allow that to happen.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Yesterday, at this time, Liam Ramos was at his preschool in Minneapolis, and today, as we speak, he is in a prison cell in Texas against the will of his parents.
I am a member of the Committee on Homeland Security, and under the Biden administration, I pushed for more resources to secure the border.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on this bill until there are real guardrails in the way that DHS is behaving.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING PRUDENT INVESTMENT OF RETIREMENT SAVINGS ACT
statements.title: PROTECTING PRUDENT INVESTMENT OF RETIREMENT SAVINGS ACT
sentences: Our Republican colleagues are once again prioritizing culture wars over working people and threatening the retirement savings of nurses, teachers, police officers, and healthcare workers, who are just trying to save for their future with peace of mind.
I rise in opposition to this bill, which will only hurt the retirement savings of millions of Americans.
Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``no'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 2025 ECONOMIC REPORT AND MANUFACTURING JOBS
statements.title: 2025 ECONOMIC REPORT AND MANUFACTURING JOBS
sentences: This weak economy is a direct result of President Trump's policies: the crazy tariffs that are raising costs for businesses and consumers, massive cuts to healthcare, and the political attacks on clean energy that are driving up energy costs.
The President claimed that his tariffs would help American manufacturing, but instead we have lost 72,000 manufacturing jobs since Liberation Day, after years of gains.
He is focused on building himself a new ballroom, naming the Kennedy Center after himself, trying to take over Greenland, and selling cryptocurrency out of the White House to enrich himself.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1834, BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1834, BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, in Rhode Island and all across the country, people are being crushed by high healthcare costs because Republicans have refused to extend the Affordable Care Act funding.
We have an opportunity now to do the right thing by the people who sent us here and to extend this Affordable Care Act funding now once and for all.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: JANUARY 6 ATTACK
statements.title: JANUARY 6 ATTACK
sentences: Mr. Speaker, do not let anyone rewrite the history of what happened on January 6, 2021.
A mob tried to overturn a free and fair election and deny the American people of our God-given right to choose our own leaders.
They attacked police officers with pipes, rocks, and other weapons.
We thank the hundreds of brave police officers who put their lives in harm's way to defend the Capitol and our democracy.

They know what it means to be patriotic Americans and their courage stands in sharp contrast to many of the Republican Members of this Congress who are too cowardly to tell the truth about what really happened on January 6.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXTEND THE TAX CREDITS
statements.title: EXTEND THE TAX CREDITS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, while Donald Trump gives billions of dollars to Argentina and gets rich selling cryptocurrency to criminals and foreign agents, millions of Americans are facing financial ruin from rising health insurance costs.

All across the country, Americans are getting letters like this from their insurance companies telling them how much their premiums are going up because of the failure of Republicans to extend the Affordable Care Act tax credits.
It is time for President Trump and House Republicans to wake up to what the American people are experiencing and extend the Affordable Care Act tax credits now.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 5371, CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 5371, CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: When billionaires wanted tax breaks, they moved mountains to make it happen.
When Donald Trump's stupid tariffs are raising the price of groceries and the cost of coffee is up 40 percent over the last year, House Republicans are silent.
They will work when billionaires need tax cuts, when Argentina needs a bailout, but when working people need relief, they go on a taxpayer- funded vacation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LIFESAVING FOOD AID
statements.title: LIFESAVING FOOD AID
sentences: I will continue to speak on this floor every day until this program is restored. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EDESIA NUTRITION
statements.title: EDESIA NUTRITION
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I will continue to speak on this floor every day until those boxes move because promises and intentions are not enough to save the lives of starving children. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOVERNMENT FUNDING AND HEALTHCARE
statements.title: GOVERNMENT FUNDING AND HEALTHCARE
sentences: It is happening because Republicans and the Trump administration just cut a trillion dollars from Medicaid, and now they are also trying to let the Affordable Care Act tax premiums expire.
We told our Republican colleagues that this is what would happen when they passed that trillion dollar cut to Medicaid.
They were so desperate to give away tax cuts to the rich, and now those people watching at home are going to be paying the bill in the form of higher healthcare costs.

Congress is about to pass a budget for next year, and we can pass a budget that restores funding for healthcare, that extends the Affordable Care Act tax premiums, that restores funding for Medicaid so that working people aren't stuck with higher costs for their health insurance.

I want to vote for a bipartisan budget that funds the government and protects healthcare for the American people, but if, as has been advertised, the Republican majority tries to rush a vote on a budget that does not fix the healthcare crisis, the healthcare crisis that they created, then I will be a ``no.'' All of my colleagues should be, as well.
I will continue to speak on this floor every day until the Trump administration honors its word and restores this program. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORE LIFESAVING FOOD AID FOR CHILDREN
statements.title: RESTORE LIFESAVING FOOD AID FOR CHILDREN
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this week, we are voting on the annual Defense bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORING LIFESAVING FOOD AID FOR MALNOURISHED CHILDREN
statements.title: RESTORING LIFESAVING FOOD AID FOR MALNOURISHED CHILDREN
sentences: It took the Trump administration 10 days to put a stop to USAID's shipments of Plumpy'Nut to starving children around the world.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORING LIFESAVING FOOD AID
statements.title: RESTORING LIFESAVING FOOD AID
sentences: Make no mistake that last week's summit in China where Putin and Modi and the North Koreans were celebrating the demise of America's leadership in the world and the rise of authoritarianism, this was one of the issues that drove that meeting.
I will keep speaking out every day until they do. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORING LIFESAVING FOOD AID FOR MALNOURISHED CHILDREN
statements.title: RESTORING LIFESAVING FOOD AID FOR MALNOURISHED CHILDREN
sentences: It is very easy for any idiot, any billionaire, who has never worked in government to go in and destroy a program, but then it is hard to rebuild it afterwards.
I will tell you, I still have friends and family from all over the country, people I meet when they hear I am from Rhode Island, they ask about that judge.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORING FOOD AID
statements.title: RESTORING FOOD AID
sentences: I will keep speaking out every day until the administration honors its word.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PLUMPY'NUT SAVES LIVES
statements.title: PLUMPY'NUT SAVES LIVES
sentences: Elon Musk, when he was still in the administration before he had his big break up with Donald Trump, even tweeted the name of the factory in my district and said that they were going to get their funding.
Number one, the tariffs that Donald Trump has put in place are a tax on small businesses and on the middle class.
Why are we putting a 10, 15, or 20 percent tariff on food that we can't even grow in the United States?

Wouldn't you know it, international travel into Rhode Island and the entire Northeast is down because, it turns out, when you threaten to invade other countries, when you enact tariffs on other countries with no clear strategy, and when you bad-mouth our allies, they don't want to come visit here anymore.
We have a hospitality industry in Rhode Island--hotels, restaurants, and other small businesses--that is facing crushing costs from tariffs and less business from international travel.
Let's prioritize tax relief for small businesses and the middle class instead of the rich.
Let's eliminate these tariffs on products that we don't even produce in the United States because we don't have the climate for it.
Time and time again when we have inquired with the administration, they say: Yes, any day now we are going to restart it.
We are asking them to execute on their stated policy.
I will continue to speak out on this floor every day until they honor their commitment to restart funding for emergency food aid around the world.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INCINERATING 500 TONS OF EMERGENCY FOOD AID
statements.title: INCINERATING 500 TONS OF EMERGENCY FOOD AID
sentences: I am going to stand on this floor every day until the administration honors its word and restores lifesaving food aid. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORE FOOD AID FUNDING
statements.title: RESTORE FOOD AID FUNDING
sentences: I will keep speaking out every day until the administration honors its word.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EDESIA PRODUCT STILL IN WAREHOUSE
statements.title: EDESIA PRODUCT STILL IN WAREHOUSE
sentences: I will keep speaking out every day until they do. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORE FUNDING FOR LIFESAVING FOOD AID
statements.title: RESTORE FUNDING FOR LIFESAVING FOOD AID
sentences: I will continue to speak on this floor until they do. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORE FUNDING FOR EDESIA'S PLUMPY'NUT
statements.title: RESTORE FUNDING FOR EDESIA'S PLUMPY'NUT
sentences: That program was halted when funding for USAID was stopped by the Trump administration.
I will set aside my prepared remarks.
We are asking them to restore the shipments and to save lives. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Our Republican colleagues are pushing a bill that would throw their constituents under the bus, a bill that flies in the face of everything they claim to stand for, all because Donald Trump wants a bill-signing photo op by the Fourth of July.

They know that, under this bill, $5 trillion of debt is being added that will be paid for by my children, your children, and their children for generations to come so that today's billionaires can get a tax break.
Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CALLING ON TRUMP ADMINISTRATION TO RESTORE LIFESAVING FOOD AID
statements.title: CALLING ON TRUMP ADMINISTRATION TO RESTORE LIFESAVING FOOD AID
sentences: I will continue to stand on this floor every day until they do. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION NEEDS TO HONOR ITS WORD ON FOOD AID
statements.title: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION NEEDS TO HONOR ITS WORD ON FOOD AID
sentences: Until recently, this was being shipped by USAID to war-torn and famine-torn areas all over the world, saving lives under Democratic and Republican administrations, until the Trump administration dismantled USAID.

Go After Criminals, Not Innocent People Mr. Speaker, Donald Trump and Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem said that they would focus on deporting violent criminals and gang members, but that is not what they are doing.
They are going after legal green card holders and asylum-seekers, locking them up with no due process.

We still haven't gotten answers about Andry Hernandez Romero, a gay makeup artist with no criminal record who legally sought asylum and who never even entered the country but was deported to a prison in El Salvador, a country that he is not even from.
Next week, we will celebrate the Fourth of July, a day when we reflect with pride on the Nation that we have always been and the values that we stand for.
I will continue to stand on the House floor every single day until they do.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORE FUNDING FOR MALNOURISHED CHILDREN
statements.title: RESTORE FUNDING FOR MALNOURISHED CHILDREN
sentences: He once said: ``We don't have to give foreign aid.
It should be getting to kids who need it, and I will continue to speak out until it does. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORE FUNDING FOR LIFESAVING FOOD AID
statements.title: RESTORE FUNDING FOR LIFESAVING FOOD AID
sentences: Lieutenant General John Bednarek said: ``Anytime that we, the United States, depart an area that we used to be in, either with USAID . . . or other soft power initiatives, some foes, whether it is China, Russia, or North Korea'' fills the gap.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: They are asking us to rubber-stamp Elon Musk's cuts to PEPFAR, which saves millions of lives treating people with HIV, funding for clean water, funding to fight malaria, funding to help people starving from famine.
Donald Trump and Republicans are doing this at the same time they are giving trillions of tax cuts to the rich.
It is not to reduce the deficit because this $9 billion is a fraction of a fraction of the tax cuts they are trying to pass for billionaires.

I have news for Elon Musk and Donald Trump and the billionaires: No matter how much money you have, no matter how many poor people you take food and medicine away from, it will not fill that hole inside of you.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FUNDING FOR EDESIA'S PLUMPY'NUT
statements.title: FUNDING FOR EDESIA'S PLUMPY'NUT
sentences: They cut aid for clean water around the world.
I will continue to speak every legislative day until they do it. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CALLING ON TRUMP ADMINISTRATION TO RESTORE LIFESAVING FOOD AID
statements.title: CALLING ON TRUMP ADMINISTRATION TO RESTORE LIFESAVING FOOD AID
sentences: Since the Trump administration paused funding for emergency food aid through USAID 5 months ago, we have heard a lot of promises.
I will continue to speak on this House floor every day until the administration honors its commitment to restore this aid. ____________________

statements.title: CALLING ON TRUMP ADMINISTRATION TO RESTORE FOOD AID
sentences: Mr. Speaker, foreign aid is not just charity.

Once again, I am going to rise in this Chamber every day until the administration keeps their word and restores funding for emergency food aid for children around the world. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORE FUNDING FOR LIFESAVING FOOD AID
statements.title: RESTORE FUNDING FOR LIFESAVING FOOD AID

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LIFESAVING FOREIGN AID
statements.title: LIFESAVING FOREIGN AID
sentences: This so-called pause on lifesaving food aid is unnecessary and unconscionable. ``Anybody who tells you that we can slash foreign aid and that will bring us to balance is lying to you.'' Foreign aid is less than 1 percent of our budget.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CUTS TO PUBLIC BROADCASTING
statements.title: CUTS TO PUBLIC BROADCASTING
sentences: Next week, our Republican colleagues are planning to bring a bill to the floor that would mean a devastating cut of funding to shows like ``Sesame Street'' and ``Mister Rogers' Neighborhood,'' all in their endless quest to find more money for tax cuts for their billionaire donors.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in opposition to the proposed Republican cuts to public broadcasting.
That is why it is so important that we continue to support PBS and public broadcasting in general.
I am asking my colleagues to evoke one of my son's favorite programs, ``Mister Rogers,'' and be a good neighbor.
We cannot allow this to happen, not only because of the moral imperative of saving the lives of starving children around the world but out of our own self-interest.
I will continue to speak on the House floor every day until we do. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise against the cruelty of a bill that would take food from the hungry and medicine from the sick and give billions in tax cuts to billionaires who don't need it.
I rise for the working people who are struggling under the weight of Donald Trump's tariffs, the largest tax increase on the middle class in a generation.
I rise for the seniors who will have nowhere to go when their nursing homes are shut down by the Medicaid cuts in this bill.
I rise for the children who will have to pay the tab for the trillions in debt that they are adding.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
statements.title: STOCK TRADING BAN FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I am joined tonight by a bipartisan group of Members who have come together to take to the floor tonight to call for Members of Congress to be banned from trading stocks.
This is material information, and Members of Congress should not have the advantage of that insider information and use that advantage to engage in stock trading.
Poll after poll has shown upwards of 90 percent of the American people supporting a ban on Members trading stocks.

Mr. Speaker, I am going to yield to some of my partners in this effort, Members who have had the courage to stand up and say that we need to enact this reform and ban Members of Congress from trading stocks once and for all.
He has introduced a bill that would put a congressional stock trading ban into effect.
Mr. Speaker, the stock trading bill that I am leading was originally introduced by Abigail Spanberger, the Representative from Virginia.
I give her a lot of credit for getting the ball rolling along with the next gentleman who I am going to introduce, who has been a fantastic partner and co-lead on the TRUST in Congress Act.
Mr. Speaker, I yield now to the gentleman from Missouri (Mr. Cleaver), a man I admire very much and a cosponsor of the TRUST in Congress Act.
Before I yield to the next Member, let me just preface this by saying, again, we have had a big couple of weeks in this fight to ban Members of Congress from trading stocks.
Our Assistant Democratic Leader is a longtime cosponsor of the legislation that I have reintroduced to ban Members of Congress from trading stocks.

Mr. Speaker, as we get ready to close here tonight, I thank my colleagues once again for their leadership on this issue and their courage because, as was said earlier, the opponents of this stock trading ban don't speak out publicly, but they are here, and they are watching and listening, and they are probably not very happy with us tonight.
We need to end congressional stock trading.
Make no mistake, this insider trading is happening.
The last 4 years in a row, Members of Congress who traded stocks outperformed the market.
I have the TRUST in Congress Act that I have been leading with Mr. Roy.
Those of us who have various versions of a stock trading bill are now working together to develop a consensus bill that we can all get behind and push together, and we are getting close.
Once again, I thank my colleagues from both sides who have had the courage to stand up tonight in support of a stock trading ban.
I know that we are going to get this done, in large part due to his leadership.
Mr. Speaker, I will take a second to thank all of my colleagues on both sides who came out tonight.
Mr. Speaker, I come from New England where we also know something about winning all the time, but we will keep it in Missouri for now.
I will end tonight with gratitude for those who started this journey before I ever got to Congress.

statements.title: EDESIA NUTRITION SAVES MALNOURISHED CHILDREN
sentences: USAID's Office of Food for Peace has funded the manufacture and distribution of this food relief to the developing world for decades, but with the closure of USAID, and despite the assurances of Secretary Rubio and other administration officials, no new orders have been submitted for the next fiscal year.

We do not have the ability to filibuster in the House like they do in the Senate, but I do have the right and the ability to stand in this Chamber every day for at least a couple of minutes to call attention to this urgent issue, and that is exactly what I intend to do until this funding is restored. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H. CON. RES. 14, CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H. CON. RES. 14, CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Donald Trump's tariffs are the biggest tax increase on the middle class in this country in generations.
The majority is trying to pass a rule that says that Congress cannot overturn these tariffs even though the Constitution gives Congress and not the President the sole authority to levy tariffs.
As Mr. McGovern said, this rule also includes the next step in a budget plan that would cut taxes for billionaires at the same time that it cuts healthcare for working people.
Mr. Speaker, the majority could cut literally every program under the Committee on Energy and Commerce except for Medicare and Medicaid and only get to $200 billion.
It can only come from kicking people off of their health insurance so that Elon Musk and the billionaires can get another tax cut that they don't need.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HANDS OFF SOCIAL SECURITY
statements.title: HANDS OFF SOCIAL SECURITY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today for the more than 120,000 people in my district who count on Social Security, a sacred promise earned through decades of hard work.
Social Security is the bedrock of retirement for the middle class.
Donald Trump and Elon Musk are firing the staff that run the Social Security office, all to find more money to pay for tax cuts for billionaires, and the impact has been devastating.
Last month alone, the Social Security website crashed four times in 10 days for hours, in one case for almost an entire day, locking retirees out of their accounts.
People who try to call the Social Security offices are on hold for hours because all the staff in the offices have been fired.

This is a violation of the sacred promise of Social Security, and I am urging this body and Members on both sides of the aisle to listen to your constituents and stand up for the working people of your districts who have paid into Social Security.
Tell Elon Musk to get his hands off of the Social Security Administration.
Recognizing Rhode Island State Police's Centennial Anniversary Mr. Speaker, I rise today to recognize a century of service from the Rhode Island State Police.

For 100 years, the men and women of the Rhode Island State Police have answered the call through hurricanes and blizzards, working on the highways, in cyberspace, and undercover, always committed to keeping Rhode Islanders safe.
Established in 1925, the Rhode Island State Police was a new type of police force.
They were tasked with reaching and serving the areas that were often underserved by the local police.
In the 1930s, the Rhode Island State Police established their headquarters in North Scituate, where they remain to this day.
Mr. Speaker, I thank the Rhode Island State Police for a century of service.

Together, we are introducing bills to expand access to tax-free savings accounts to cover the costs of medical expenses, to improve communication between Medicare and caregivers to streamline the benefits process, and to create a new $5,000 tax credit to help offset the costs of family caregiving.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ECONOMIC POPULISM
statements.title: ECONOMIC POPULISM
sentences: They see billionaires on Wall Street and in Silicon Valley get richer while they can't afford everything on their grocery list.
It looks like making billionaires like Elon Musk pay their fair share so that we can give tax relief to the middle class.
It looks like passing the PRO Act so that workers in retail and fast food can join a union and earn a ticket to the middle class like my grandfather did in his factory.
It looks like universal preschool and affordable childcare, not just because it is good for kids, but because it helps parents work and build their savings.

statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 20, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY RELATING TO "ENERGY CONSERVATION PROGRAM: ENERGY CONSERVATION...

Instead of focusing on the cost of living or making America safer, Republicans are planning a massive giveaway to the rich, with working people picking up the tab.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING FEDERAL WORKERS
statements.title: SUPPORTING FEDERAL WORKERS
sentences: These are the workers who make sure that Social Security checks go out to your parents and grandparents.

When Donald Trump and Elon Musk attack these public servants, it means fewer law enforcement officers working to keep us safe, slower disaster response for families hit by severe storms, and longer wait times for Social Security and Medicare.
To find money to pay for tax cuts for billionaires.
Here in Congress, we are going to fight to oppose Donald Trump and Elon Musk's baseless and cruel attacks against those who have devoted their lives to service.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROSPECT MEDICAL FILING FOR BANKRUPTCY
statements.title: PROSPECT MEDICAL FILING FOR BANKRUPTCY
sentences: Unfortunately, this is a day that many of us feared would come because, for years, Leonard Green & Partners, the private equity firm that owned Prospect Medical, and executives of the company engaged in outrageous profiteering, buying up hospitals and extracting hundreds of millions of dollars of management fees and dividends, money that should have been spent on patient care.
In the decade that private equity firm Leonard Green owned Prospect Medical, they extracted over half a billion dollars from the hospitals they owned.
The time has come for Congress to take a hard look at the consequences of private equity ownership of hospitals.

Honoring Officers for Serving on January 6 Mr. Speaker, 4 years ago last week, a violent mob attacked our Nation's Capitol, assaulted police officers, and threatened to kill elected officials, all with the goal of blocking the results of the Presidential election and denying the will of the American people.
On that dark day, hundreds of Capitol and Metropolitan Police officers bravely did their duty, putting their lives in harm's way to protect this building, the people in it, and our very democracy.
Over 140 police officers suffered injuries, including broken bones, concussions, and PTSD.

Congress passed, and President Biden signed, a law to honor the Capitol Police officers who defended our country during the January 6 riots with a plaque here in the Capitol Building that they fought to defend.
Every day that my Republican colleagues delay is an insult to the brave officers who served on January 6 and who continue to protect us day in and day out.

I am committed to working with State officials and my colleagues in the Rhode Island congressional delegation to clean up the mess that Leonard Green left behind and to do our best to save Fatima and Roger Williams and stabilize our State's healthcare system.
Mark my words, we will not stop there.
